lifecyclePolicy: Retire a tool only for verified obsolescence, an unfixable security problem, or sustained replacement by a better maintained equivalent. Low aggregate counters alone are not deletion evidence. Keep useful long-tail tools in the directory while focusing the homepage on high-intent tasks.

indexReview.reason: Five comparison pages measured 83–84% eight-word-shingle similarity and contained unverified competitor and unlimited-use claims. They remain available to direct visitors but are excluded from the sitemap and marked noindex until individually researched.
